content.title: College & Schools | Gonzaga University
content.text: College & Schools Gonzaga offers 16 undergraduate degrees through 53 majors, 68 minors and 73 concentrations; 23 master’s programs; and five doctorate degrees. College of Arts & Sciences College of Arts & Sciences The College develops women and men for others, ready to face the intellectual, vocational and spiritual challenges of today and tomorrow. School of Business Administration School of Business Administration Our AACSB-accredited the business programs are rooted in the Jesuit understanding that business decisions have ethical implications. School of Education School of Education Gonzaga's School of Education prepares transformational leaders who are committed to excellence and serve others in a diverse and global community. School of Engineering & Applied Science School of Engineering & Applied Science The School of Engineering and Applied Science at Gonzaga University produces broadly-educated and capable engineers and computer scientists ready to contribute innovative solutions for a better world. Gonzaga in Florence Gonzaga in Florence Since 1963 Gonzaga in Florence has offered students, faculty, and alumni of Gonzaga University and our partner Jesuit institutions the chance to engage with the rich culture of Florence, Italy, and Europe. School of Health Sciences School of Health Sciences The School of Health Sciences at Gonzaga University prepares students for careers in human sciences and health professions. School of Law School of Law Finding solutions & success in an ever-changing legal world. School of Leadership Studies School of Leadership Studies Gonzaga University's School of Leadership Studies creates, educates, and supports leaders across a diverse spectrum of professions and vocations.
